reason: A more directly tests how chemical heterogeneity and surface segregation govern the fixed Fe–Ni–Cr–Co–Cu nanoparticle system, with plausible surface-energy-driven effects and a controlled thermal comparison. B relies on a weak extrapolation from bulk CoCrCu(Ni), introduces unsupported quantitative shifts, and proposes neutron radiography that cannot resolve segregation in individual 20–100 nm particles.
